product_overview: LibraLink is a web-based library management system that helps librarians manage the catalog, process book circulation, and handle reservations. It streamlines core library operations through authenticated staff workflows and printable circulation records.
core_goals: Let librarians view an operational dashboard and navigate to key management areas
Allow librarians to maintain the book catalog by adding, editing, searching, and removing books
Enable librarians to process book loans and returns for borrowers
Let librarians review pending reservations and approve or reject them
Provide printable receipts and circulation records for checkout and return actions

features.name: Librarian Dashboard
features.description: Provides an overview page for librarians with quick access to management sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /librarian/index.php -> View the dashboard overview -> Choose a management section to continue

features.name: Manage Catalog
features.description: Lets librarians review the catalog and perform book maintenance tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to /librarian/catalog.php -> View the list of books -> Search or filter the catalog -> Open a book for editing -> Update the book details -> Save changes and return to the catalog list
Navigate to /librarian/catalog.php -> View the list of books -> Start adding a new book -> Enter the new book details -> Save the new book -> See the book appear in the catalog
Navigate to /librarian/catalog.php -> View the list of books -> Select a book to remove -> Confirm the deletion -> See the book removed from the catalog

features.name: Process Checkout
features.description: Allows librarians to issue a book copy to a borrower and create a loan record.
user_flows: Navigate to /librarian/checkout.php -> Enter borrower ID -> Enter book copy ID -> Submit the loan form -> See the checkout confirmation and receipt

features.name: Process Checkin
features.description: Allows librarians to process the return of a borrowed book copy.
user_flows: Navigate to /librarian/checkin.php -> Enter book copy ID -> Submit the return form -> See the checkin confirmation and receipt

features.name: Manage Reservations
features.description: Lets librarians review reservation requests and decide whether to approve or reject them.
user_flows: Navigate to /librarian/reservations.php -> View pending reservations -> Open a reservation for review -> Approve the reservation -> See the reservation status update
Navigate to /librarian/reservations.php -> View pending reservations -> Open a reservation for review -> Reject the reservation -> See the reservation status update

features.name: Librarian Dashboard
features.description: View system overview and quick links

features.name: Manage Catalog
features.description: View, add, edit, and delete books
user_interactions: Click add book to create a new book
Click edit to modify an existing book
Click delete to remove a book
